title: `setGatewayAddress` incorrectly updates address of the gateway
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium, gateway will still has it's old address  **Likelihood:** Medium, only occurs if the user decides to set a new address for his gateway  ## Description  The gateway owner can set a new address for it using `setGatewayAddress` function.
